title: Spectral problems on open-book structures with singularly perturbed density: the limit operator
summary: We investigate the spectral problem arising in the asymptotic analysis of vibrations of open-book structures with a mass density perturbed near the binding. The limiting problem is go\-ver\-ned by a non-self-adjoint block operator matrix coupling the macroscopic and microscopic components of the model. We describe the spectrum of this operator and completely characterize its eigenspaces and root subspaces.
